decisions.reason: As a low-cost carpet close to the core range, it still has enough residual option value after two years to justify staying on the market absent clear negative evidence.
This premium hand-knotted carpet remains a design-led niche option that is likely inexpensive to keep relative to its branding and project potential.
Because it overlaps with other carpet introductions and has now had time to reveal its appeal, management would likely prune it and reallocate resources to stronger options.
The swivel shell chair line supports the firm's push into flexible workplace concepts, so its strategic upside still outweighs the cost of continuing it.
